d: The Warriors defeated the Lakers, 112-95 tonight in Golden State. Stephen Curry contributed a team-high 31 points to go with 8 three pointers 6 assists and 4 rebounds, with Brandin Podziemski of the Warriors adding an additional 21 points (7-15 FG, 4-9 3P), 5 rebounds, and 6 assists in the game. Luka Dončić finished with a team-high 37 points along with 7 rebounds for the Lakers in the losing effort. The Warriors improve their record to 3-3 with the win, while the Lakers fall to 4-2 for the season.
